verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago is a payments API platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The cited docs cover the MCP server, CLI, checkout products and webhooks, none of which bear on versioning, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
